body:
![logo](https://i.postimg.cc/43Rxy1PG/logo.png)
## About
Adds Phoenix and Thunder armor, crystals, and gems, as well as weapons, tools, and armor crafted from the new materials.

<details>
<summary>[🛡️] Armor</summary>

### Thunder Armor
  
Craft and use a ![Apple](https://i.postimg.cc/k4ZgxSfD/sky-apple.png) **Sky Apple** to summon a powerful thunderstorm. During the storm, lightning strikes will leave behind ![Sphere](https://i.postimg.cc/PxBwQJMM/sky-sphere.png) **Sky Spheres**. Collect these rare materials and forge them into the ![Thunder](https://i.postimg.cc/SsH2XG4d/thunder-armor.png) **Thunder Armor** set and other equipment.

### Phoenix Armor

Travel to the Nether and search for **Phoenixes**. Obtain ![Phoenix Feather](https://i.postimg.cc/0QCTpKvF/feather.png) **Phoenix Feathers**, then combine them with ![Fel Ingot](https://i.postimg.cc/FHdX2KgX/fel.png) **Fel Ingots** to forge the complete ![Phoenix](https://i.postimg.cc/7ZxzhwZS/phoenix-armor.png) **Phoenix Armor** set.

</details>

<details>
<summary>[💀] Mobs</summary>

### Phoenixe
Peaceful inhabitants of the **Nether Wastes**. Their legendary feathers are used to forge the **Phoenix Armor**.

### Robot
Robots are hostile mechanical enemies that patrol the world in small groups. They will attack any nearby player.

</details>
